profile.headline: Software Engineer | Amazon | BCG | Brightcove | MSCS@Northeastern University | Student@CodePath
profile.summary:
Front-end/Fullstack engineer experienced in Agile development. Fluent in JavaScript/TypeScript and
related frameworks like React, Node, web technologies from industry experience, Python from extensive projects
and data structures and algorithms training. Passionate about design and intuitive user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Developed supply chain application for Fortune 500 logistics company, tracking deliveries across the US with interactive map, estimated to reduce cost by 40% with VueJS for front-end and C# .NET for back-end.
• Increased front-end unit tests coverage by 12% leveraging jest, recovered 100% end-to-end tests with Cypress
• Refactored code base to become reusable, boosted robustness by 10%; built new page and fixed 12% bugs.
• Documented full data flow of the application, assisting 15% hand-over transition process to client.
• Collaborated, communicated in cross-functional agile development environment with internal team and clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Testing · C# · ASP.NET · Full-Stack Development · Front-End Design · JavaScript · VueJS · .NET Framework · Front-End Development · Software Development

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer Coop
positions.description:
• Worked with Live module team for one of the biggest video streaming platforms.
• Converted class-component to function-component in ReactJS and TypeScript, reducing 20% of technical debt.
• Added a delete all feature, reducing cost by 11%
• Enhanced HTML/CSS codebase to ensure a responsive UI and effortless UX, fixing 40% bugs.
• Wrote JIRA stories to list technical deprecation, sorted by priorities.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Technologies · Software Testing · Programming · Computer Science · Data Structures · Algorithms · Analytical Skills · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Communication · Front-End Design · Oral Communication · Computer Engineering · JavaScript · Problem Solving · Code Review · Front-End Development · Software Development · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Agile development team to deliver regular updates to business teams and project managers
• Build common, reusable React components for multi-phase financial technology project with Fortune 500 Company
• Support unit testing, business analyzing, UX/UI conceptualizing and communicating between internal departments and partners in the US
• Demo and English coach for Scrum Team, created a standardized demo template now adopted and utilized by 20+ colleagues
positions.insights: Skills: Web Technologies · Software Testing · Programming · Computer Science · Data Structures · Algorithms · Analytical Skills · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Communication · Front-End Design · Oral Communication · Computer Engineering · JavaScript · Problem Solving · Code Review · Front-End Development · Software Development · React.js

positions.title: Cast Member
positions.description:
Deliver daily Guest service in Fortune 100 Company, with an average annual attendance of 52 million visitors
Partner with other Entertainment branch Cast Members to enhance the Disney vacation experience and capture exceptional photography
Technical assistance to Guests regarding Disney web and mobile technology
Sales and Guest service at Camera Center, ensuring consistent revenue stream and Guest’s satisfaction
Manage and maintain photography equipment and store
Received Cast Compliment, Photo(s) of The Week, Recognition

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Supervise, mentor and assist a floor of 36 students.
Develop and implement programs to strengthen the community.
Wrote incident reports, handled paperwork and records of residents and ensured a safe and welcoming environment
Create monthly themed bulletin boards to inspire/educate/motivate residents

positions.title: Justice, Troy University Supreme Court
positions.description: Attend hearings of serious policy violation cases of Troy students, question said students and discuss with other justices to make final verdict regarding the issue

positions.title: Yearbook Designer
positions.description:
Design Troy University yearbook, which is printed 750 copies yearly. 
Also assist with other staff on photography and marketing activities to promote sales

positions.title: Director of International Relations Board, Student Government Association
positions.description: Programmed, executed media projects and events that helped engage more international students. Designed a series of visual explanation for Homecoming and organized a panel talk show about on-campus clubs and organizations

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description:
Focused on digital art, character design and industrial business tactics. 
Created an original series of fantasy characters that are blended between human and vegetables

positions.title: Summer Camp STEM Teacher
positions.description: Taught summer classes on STEM subjects to 50 elementary and middle school students

honors.title: Silver Prize, Lion Hack @ Columbia University Blockchain Club
honors.description:
First annual hackathon hosted by Columbia Blockchain. 200 participants.
Won prize for best use for CyberConnect: a platform to display following/follower list on the chain.
Worked in team of 5, structured the NextJS frontend layout and assisted teammates with TypeScript syntax and data manipulation.
honors.issuer: Issued by Columbia University Hackathon · Apr 2022

honors.title: ADDY Award in Illustration
honors.description: The American Advertising Awards is one of the industry's largest creative competitions, attracting nearly 35,000 professional and student entries each year through local club competitions. The mission of the American Advertising Awards is to recognize and reward the spirit of creative excellence in advertising.
honors.issuer: Issued by American Advertising Federation  · Apr 2019

volunteerExperiences.description:
Student Welfare Committee (08/2015-04/2016)
Campus Life Committee (08/2016-04/2017)
Hosted, directed entertainment shows to promote Vietnamese cultures, especially the Lunar New Year shows that attracted more than 300 attendees each year
